responsibilities.label: Hosting infrastructure
responsibilities.explanation: The provider operates the machines that run your app. You still maintain your code and its libraries. A container packages code and its required software; if you supply one, you also maintain that software and its security updates. A virtual machine is a software-defined computer running on shared physical hardware.

responsibilities.label: Publishing changes
responsibilities.explanation: Connect your code or a container image, which is the packaged version of a container. Set build commands, app settings and checks before making changes public. Automatic publishing does not decide which changes are safe to release.

responsibilities.label: Keeping app data
responsibilities.explanation: This row concerns data that must survive an app restart or replacement, not browser files or temporary working files. A separate database or file-storage product is marked Excluded, even if the same provider sells it. An attached disk must be configured and protected against data loss.
values: Use R2, D1 or another data service

responsibilities.label: Domains and secrets
responsibilities.explanation: Connect a domain name to your app and store secrets such as passwords and access keys safely. Domain Name System (DNS) settings direct visitors to the right server. Even with automatic security certificates, you must prove domain ownership and keep development and production secrets separate.
